column1: # WHAT THIS IS. Every row is a fact the named document states in canonical
# Subject predicate Object form. The source sentence is included so the label
# is checkable rather than a matter of opinion: GoldExtractionSetTest asserts
# each sentence appears verbatim in that document, so a fabricated or drifted
# HOW IT WAS LABELLED. By transcribing sentences that the corpus states
# literally, constrained to the 28 registered predicates. Not by a language
# model, and not by looking at what any extractor returned.
# WHAT IT CANNOT TELL YOU -- read this before quoting any number from it.
# The demo corpus states every extractable fact in canonical form and its prose
# is deliberately uninformative (document 24 states no extractable fact at all).
# So this set measures transcription and entity resolution, NOT extraction from
# natural prose. A model will score near 100% here by pattern-matching, and that
# number says nothing about how it would perform on a contracts pack or a board
# minute. Presenting it as extraction accuracy would be misleading, and the
# 99 rows, 23 documents, 15 of the 28 registered predicates. The 13 unused
# predicates are absent because the corpus never states one -- their absence is
# recorded rather than padded with invented rows.
